# langsmith_sandbox_registry (Resource)

Manages a private container image registry credential used by LangSmith sandboxes.

Registries are addressed **by name**, so changing `name` forces a new resource.

`username` and `password` are **write-only**: the LangSmith API accepts them on create/update but never returns them. This has two consequences:

* Terraform cannot detect drift on `username` or `password`. If the credentials are changed outside of Terraform, the provider will not notice.
* **Importing a registry cannot recover them.** Immediately after an import both attributes are absent from state, so the next plan will show a change for them and re-write the credentials from your configuration. This is expected; apply the plan to converge.

Import accepts the registry name:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_sandbox_registry.example my-registry
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "registry_password" {
  description = "Password or access token for the private container registry."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

# A private container image registry that LangSmith sandboxes pull images from.
#
# `username` and `password` are write-only: the LangSmith API accepts them but
# never returns them, so Terraform cannot detect drift on them and cannot
# recover them on import.
resource "langsmith_sandbox_registry" "example" {
  name     = "my-private-registry"
  url      = "ghcr.io"
  username = "my-registry-user"
  password = var.registry_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the registry. This is the key the API addresses the registry by, so changing it forces a new resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password (or access token) used to authenticate to the registry. This is write-only: the API never returns it, so Terraform cannot detect drift on it and cannot populate it on import. After importing a registry, the first plan will show a change for this attribute and re-write the credentials from your configuration.
- `url` (String) The URL of the container image registry (for example `ghcr.io` or `123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`).
- `username` (String) The username used to authenticate to the registry. This is write-only: the API never returns it, so Terraform cannot detect drift on it and cannot populate it on import.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the registry.
- `created_by` (String) The identifier of the user who created the registry.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the registry.
- `updated_at` (String) The last modification timestamp of the registry.
- `updated_by` (String) The identifier of the user who last modified the registry.
